fact: In Nyangoma Mwesingwa v. Cecilia Maliganya the Personal Data Protection Commission ordered the named respondent, a seller of maternal and child products, to pay TZS 20,000,000 damages and a TZS 5,000,000 fine to the Commission and to delete a child's photos within 14 days (the text gives no decision date; the decision is dated 19 August 2025 in lead 2).
title: Landmark Ruling: Personal Data & Unauthorized Commercial Use of a Child's Photo
